material.title: 美联储联邦公开市场委员会决定下调联邦基金利率目标区间25个基点
material.bodyOriginal: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace. Job gains have slowed, and the unemployment rate has moved up but remains low. Inflation has made further progress toward the Committee's 2 percent objective but remains somewhat elevated. In light of the progress on inflation and the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent.

material.title: 中国人民银行决定下调金融机构存款准备金率0.5个百分点
material.bodyZh: 为坚持支持性的货币政策立场，加大货币政策调控强度，提高货币政策调控精准性，中国人民银行决定：自2026年9月27日起，下调金融机构存款准备金率0.5个百分点（不含已执行5%存款准备金率的金融机构）。下调后，金融机构加权平均存款准备金率约为6.6%。

material.title: 标普500指数历史性首次收于5800点上方 科技与金融权重股领涨
material.originalTitle: S&P 500 closes above 5,800 for first time as bank earnings fuel rally
material.bodyOriginal: The S&P 500 rallied 0.8% on Friday to finish at 5,815.03, crossing the 5,800 milestone for the first time in history. Financial stocks led the broad-based advance following stronger-than-expected quarterly results from major lenders, while tech heavyweights provided sustained momentum amid easing Treasury yields.

material.title: 沪深两市全天成交额达2.59万亿元 刷新历史单日成交极值
material.bodyZh: 9月30日，A股全天放量暴涨，沪深两市全天成交额突破2.59万亿元人民币，创下历史单日成交新纪录。上证指数单日大涨8.06%收复3300点关口，创业板指飙升15.36%，券商、半导体、消费电子等权重板块批量涨停，多只宽基ETF成交创下历史天量。

material.title: 英伟达公布第二季度财报：营收300亿美元超预期 数据中心业务同比增154%
material.originalTitle: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2025
material.bodyOriginal: NVIDIA reported revenue for the second quarter ended July 28, 2024, of $30.0 billion, up 122% from a year ago and up 15% from the previous quarter, surpassing consensus estimates of $28.7 billion. Data Center revenue was a record $26.3 billion, up 154% from a year ago. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.67, up 168% from a year ago. The company approved an additional $50.0 billion in share repurchase authorization.

material.title: 工商银行发布2026年半年度报告：营业收入4264亿元 资产规模突破47万亿元
material.bodyZh: 中国工商银行发布2026年半年度业绩报告。上半年集团实现营业收入4264.06亿元，实现归母净利润1712.96亿元。截至6月末，总资产规模突破47.1万亿元，较上年末增长5.4%。不良贷款率1.35%，拨备覆盖率218.43%，资产质量保持平稳可控，同时董事会建议派发中期普通股现金股息约511亿元。

material.title: 证监会对特大跨市场操纵证券期货案开出行政处罚决定书 没一罚五没收违法所得18亿元
material.bodyZh: 中国证监会依法对个别不法机构及操纵团伙利用多账户跨市场操纵多只标的证券的违法行为作出行政处罚，没收违法所得并处以五倍顶格罚款，合计罚没款超18亿元，同时对相关主要责任人采取终身证券市场禁入措施。证监会重申将坚持'零容忍'执法底线，坚决维护资本市场公平交易秩序。

material.title: 高盛推出基于生成式AI的机构级实时量化合规风控引擎
material.originalTitle: Goldman Sachs rolls out generative AI risk engine for institutional trading desks
material.bodyOriginal: Goldman Sachs has deployed a novel generative AI-powered quantitative risk framework across its global prime services and fixed income trading desks. The platform synthesizes multi-venue regulatory feeds, real-time counterparty VaR simulations, and cross-asset limit breaches in sub-second latency, marking one of the largest production deployments of LLMs in tier-one investment banking infrastructure.

material.originalTitle: BIS Quarterly Review: Leverage in non-bank financial intermediaries and offshore dollar liquidity
material.bodyOriginal: The Bank for International Settlements released its latest Quarterly Review examining structural leverage in hedge funds and private credit markets. The empirical study highlights that synthetic dollar borrowing through FX swaps poses systemic rollover vulnerabilities under rapid interest rate shifts, calling for standardized collateral haircuts and enhanced international liquidity backstops.

material.title: 关于金融统计数据报送系统业务数据采集接口规范格式微调的技术补充说明
material.bodyZh: 各相关接入银行业金融机构：针对近期部分机构咨询的新一代数据直报系统表样B03字段格式问题，现明确如下：第18列'机构内部编码'由原先固定8位字符变更为支持8-16位变长字符，校验规则保持一致。请各机构技术部门在下次月度例行系统升级时更新校验文件。
